preconditions.description: The number of problems n must be between 1 and 5000.
The required balance m must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(scores) == n and all(1 <= score <= 10**9 for score in scores))
postconditions.description: If no valid score distribution exists, output -1; otherwise, output n scores where each score is a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(scores[i] < scores[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: The scores must be in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) for k in range(j + 1, n) if scores[i] + scores[j] == scores[k]) == m
postconditions.description: The number of triples (i, j, k) such that a_i + a_j = a_k must be exactly m.
